item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Symmetric keys on Azure Key Vault Premium
item.description:
Azure Key Vault Premium now generally supports symmetric keys, using the oct-HSM key type with the AES algorithm. This follows the public preview introduced in July 2026 and makes symmetric encryption available directly in Key Vault Premium.

  • Source: Azure Updates
